exposure: L-thyroxine (20 mg/kg/day) and 4-pregnane-3,20-dione (1.0 mg/kg every 72 h)
cohort: Thirty artificially inseminated bitches, including 10 with a history of normal pregnancies and 20 diagnosed with reproductive hypothyroidism and hypoluteoidism.
finding: Combination therapy of L-thyroxine and 4-pregnane-3,20-dione successfully maintained pregnancy to term in bitches with concomitant hypothyroidism and hypoluteoidism, achieving plasma P4 levels similar to healthy controls, whereas L-thyroxine alone did not prevent embryonic death.
mod_finding: Pregnancy in the successful treatment group was maintained until a scheduled cesarean section on day 61.
gest_age: Term (approximately 61-63 days of gestation, with C-section on day 61 for treatment group)
